card.description: A monolithic obsidian resonator carved with ancient Ethiopian glyphs, embedded with crystalline circuitry that hums with bio‑luminescent energy, resting on a basalt pedestal etched with runic patterns. The glyphs pulse in sync with the ambient hum of the temple’s machinery, casting a subtle, otherworldly glow across the surrounding stone.
visual_anatomy: **Body/Form:** monolithic obsidian core, basalt pedestal, integrated crystalline lattice
**Face/Sensors:** no face; sensor arrays embedded within glyphs
**Key Features:** pulsing glyphs, crystalline lattice, bio‑luminescent glow, basalt pedestal, integrated power conduits
evolution: Phase 1 (Initial Activation): core emits low‑frequency hum, glyphs glow faintly
Phase 2 (Full Resonance): core vibrates, glyphs blaze, crystalline lattice expands
props: Item: Basalt Pedestal – heavy, carved with runic patterns
Item: Ancient Scroll – parchment with faded inscriptions
